hostname.description: The OneTrust hostname such as app.onetrust.com, app-eu.onetrust.com, app-de.onetrust.com, app-uk.onetrust.com, app-apac.onetrust.com, trial.onetrust.com, or uat.onetrust.com.

get.description: Use this API to retrieve a list of event types for which user and system activity are tracked. Additional filter criteria can be applied to further filter results by product area or record type. The response will include details such as the code, name, object type, and product area for each event type.

parameters.description: Object Type Names for which Event Types are required
